reason: The policy never uses action 2 (main engine) or action 0 (do nothing). The main engine is essential for descending and landing. We add direct rewards for using these actions under appropriate conditions: (1) main_engine_bonus: +0.5 when action==2 and y>0 (above ground) to encourage descending; (2) stable_idle_bonus: +0.2 when action==0 and speed<0.1 and |angle|<0.1 and y<0.1 (near ground) to encourage stable hovering before landing. We also reduce distance_shaping weight from -10 to -2 to prevent dominance, and increase hovering_penalty from -0.1 to -0.5 to discourage indefinite hovering. These changes are stateless and directly target the unused actions.
changed_design: added main_engine_bonus: +0.5 if action==2 and y>0 (above ground) to encourage descending
added stable_idle_bonus: +0.2 if action==0 and speed<0.1 and |angle|<0.1 and y<0.1 (near ground) to encourage stable idle before landing
rejected_patterns_avoided: Not repeating stateful progress bonus: main_engine_bonus is stateless, based on current y and action.
Not repeating single_component_dominance: distance_shaping weight reduced from -10 to -2, budget ~2*max_distance (~2.8) per step, total per episode ~200, down from 730.
Not repeating unused_discrete_actions: direct action-based rewards for actions 0 and 2.
action_coverage_plan: Action 2 (main engine) is directly rewarded with +0.5 per step when the lander is above ground (y>0). This creates a strong incentive to fire the main engine to descend. Action 0 (do nothing) is rewarded with +0.2 per step when the lander is stable, near the ground (y<0.1), and upright. This encourages the policy to use action 0 during the final approach phase. Actions 1 and 3 remain useful for orientation control. The increased hovering_penalty (-0.5) discourages indefinite hovering without descending.
